complete_suite.live_partition: TLS handshake, iptables DROP, traffic failure, and authenticated recovery passed

trusted_providers.attestation_binding: cluster, replica, term, last sequence, chain digest, key ID, and key generation
trusted_providers.record_binding: cluster, replica, term, key generation, key ID, sequence, previous digest, record digest, and payload
trusted_providers.trust_store: explicit provisioned public keys keyed by cluster/replica/key ID/generation
trusted_providers.fail_closed: unknown keys, generation mismatch, malformed lengths, tampering, and invalid signatures reject

limitations: The partition test validates the local TCP/mTLS transport harness, not a production multi-node cluster or physical network fabric.
The providers use explicitly provisioned Ed25519 public keys; TPM/secure-enclave-backed key loading and live KMS rotation remain external integration work.
The daemon CLI now requires --trusted-key entries, but production certificate rotation, key revocation, and snapshot verification remain pending.
Vault dev container integration remains environment-gated when Docker is unavailable.
